intro.title: Secure Token Rotation
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a Vue component that securely rotates an authentication token. You'll learn how to use Vue's reactive state and lifecycle hooks to manage and refresh tokens at set intervals. The core concept involves implementing a timer that automatically fetches a new token from a mock API before the old one expires. You'll work with Vue's ref, onMounted, and onUnmounted to handle state changes and cleanup, ensuring your application stays secure and responsive.
intro.usecase: Secure token rotation is essential in any application that maintains user sessions, such as banking dashboards, e-commerce platforms, or collaborative tools like project management software. When users stay logged in for extended periods, their authentication tokens need periodic refreshing to prevent unauthorized access while maintaining seamless interaction. Developers implement this pattern behind the scenes in user profile panels, admin interfaces, and data visualization dashboards to ensure continuous security without interrupting the user experience. This prevents session hijacking while allowing users to work uninterrupted in long-running applications.
